subject: Private deployment: upgrade comms, phased rollout & rollback matrix
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cameron Blake <cameron@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment: upgrade comms, phased rollout & rollback matrix

Team —

Per BigBank's request we need to schedule the next Private runtime patch (v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0) for their on-prem/VPC deployment and lock down a clear communications and rollback plan. Draft attached: "upgrade_matrix_v2.xlsx" + a short comms draft in "comm_plan_draft.md". High-level asks below so we can finalize before Friday: 

- Proposed maintenance window: Sat Mar 27 01:00–05:00 PT (4h) with a 1h canary phase followed by bulk cutover.
- Version pinning: customer currently pinned to 3.2.1; we will propose a soft pin to 3.3.0 for 30 days post-upgrade, with automatic fallback to 3.2.1 if health signals fail.
- Rollback criteria (initial): CPU/GPU mem > 85% sustained for 10m, p99 latency degradation > 40%, error rate increase > 3x baseline, or failed KV cache warmup after canary.
- Network changes: small route table change to support new sidecar metrics; CAM needs to confirm no IP conflicts.
- Audit/compliance: ensure audit logs for config changes and a KMS key rotation window is scheduled with Neha.

Please review the matrix and suggest edits inline. Specific asks: 
  * Mateo — confirm canary cluster size and gate thresholds.
  * Karthik — ops orchestration steps and any preflight health checks we should add.
  * Neha — compliance gating and evidence we must provide to BigBank.
  * Dylan — runbook owner for rollback; include checklist for snapshot/restore.

If we agree on Sat 27, I'll send the official notice to BigBank and schedule the 01:00 calendar invite.

Thanks,
Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cameron Blake <cameron@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: upgrade comms, phased rollout & rollback matrix

Kimberly — quick read through the matrix. A few notes: 

1) Canary sizing: recommend 10% of production capacity or a minimum of 2 GPU nodes (whichever is higher) for 60m. That gives us prefix/KV cache warmup observation without fully exposing all traffic.
2) Gate thresholds: add a third gate for model-level token divergence (automated prompt smoke tests) — if generation quality drops by > 8% on our golden prompts, fail canary.
3) Snapshot cadence: ensure we take both L0 (VM) and model checkpoint snapshots pre-cutover. If snapshot+restore time > 45m for BigBank infra, schedule extra buffer.

Also suggest adding a nightly preflight run for three nights prior to the window to validate images and sidecar versions on a staging clone. I'll update the workbook with canary numbers.

On the rollback approach: prefer a staged rollback (canary -> region -> full) rather than full immediate revert unless critical. Dylan, can you confirm the rollback playbook includes automatic drain and token blackhole steps?

Mateo
Principal Site Reliability Engineer

From: Cameron Blake <cameron@acmecloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T13:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: upgrade comms, phased rollout & rollback matrix

Thanks for the heads up, Kimberly. A couple of constraints from our side (BigBank's VPC team):

- Blackout windows: BigBank has a regulatory blackout from 02:30–03:30 PT on Sat due to overnight batch jobs; we cannot touch routes or IPs during that hour. That conflicts with the current canary window.
- IP whitelisting: after upgrade the sidecar metrics endpoint will originate from a new ephemeral IP range (10.200.5.0/24). Need confirmation we can add that to their VPC ACLs and firewall rules at least 24h in advance.
- Network diagram attached: "acme_vpc_routes.png" — please verify the proposed route change won't overlap the DB migration VLAN.

If we must move the canary earlier, we can do 00:15–01:15 PT for canary and bulk after the blackout, but that compresses the lead time for rollback.

Cameron
Integration Lead, ACME Cloud Services

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cameron Blake <cameron@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T17:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: upgrade comms, phased rollout & rollback matrix

Couple of compliance/controls items we'll need to bake in before sending the official notice to BigBank: 

- Audit trail: all config changes and deployment steps must be pushed to the customer's audit S3 bucket (or provided via secure share) within 2 hours of completion. Add step in runbook to capture run-level logs and signed manifests.
- KMS rotation: do not schedule a KMS rotation inside the 30-day soft-pin window. If BigBank wants a rotation, schedule it 48h before the upgrade or 30 days after.
- Evidence pack: BigBank will request pre/post snapshots and syscall-level audit logs for the canary hosts. Prepare a redacted evidence pack template we can drop into DocShare.
- Fallback policy: strongly prefer an automated graceful traffic shift to hosted fallback for 30–120m during rollback if their infra allows it. If not possible, ensure we have a documented manual fallback and escalation path.

I'll attach the evidence checklist to the workbook and mark the gating items.

Neha
Security & Compliance Lead

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cameron Blake <cameron@acmecloud.com>, BigBank SecOps <audits@bigbank.com>
Date: 2027-03-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: upgrade comms, phased rollout & rollback matrix

Thanks all — consolidated next steps below and decisions so we can lock the notice.

Decisions: 
- Maintenance window: Sat Mar 27 00:15–05:00 PT. Canary 00:15–01:15, blackout 02:30–03:30 (no route changes), bulk cutover after 03:30.
- Version pin: 3.3.0 soft-pin for 30 days; automatic rollback to 3.2.1 if any of the primary gates trip.
- Rollback approach: staged rollback (canary -> region -> full) unless critical failure; add hosted fallback as preferred option if customer consents.

Action owners: 
- Mateo: update matrix with canary node counts, add golden-prompt smoke tests (due 2027-03-24 12:00 PT).
- Karthik: finalize orchestration steps, preflight checklist, and snapshot run times (due 2027-03-24 18:00 PT).
- Neha: finalize evidence pack template and list of logs to push to BigBank (due 2027-03-24 15:00 PT).
- Dylan: publish rollback playbook with drain/blackhole commands and time estimates (due 2027-03-24 20:00 PT).
- Cameron / ACME: confirm IP whitelist change timing and approve route diagram (please respond by 2027-03-23 17:00 PT).

I'll incorporate all updates into the workbook and send the customer-facing maintenance notice after we have the items above. Calendar invite + runbook link will follow.

Attachments: upgrade_matrix_v2.xlsx, comm_plan_draft.md, acme_vpc_routes.png

Kimberly
Senior Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
